summary: Your blog can also be your federated network. Not sure we need ActivityPub spaces at all for stuff like #el30. RSS will work, and for more social features been playing with micropub and microsub readers (ActivityPub split in half with less technical weight).
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Your blog can also be your federated network. Not sure we need ActivityPub spaces at all for stuff like #el30. RSS will work, and for more social features been playing with micropub and microsub readers (ActivityPub split in half with less technical weight).
